name: claude-usage
tagline: Every Claude account's plan limits, in one terminal command.
description: CLI that shows Claude plan usage limits (5-hour session, weekly, per-model) for every Claude Code account on your machine at once — the claude.ai Usage page, in your terminal, across accounts.

positioning.audience: Claude Code users who switch between several accounts (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR)
positioning.wedge: See which account still has headroom before starting a long session, without logging into each one
differentiators: real plan percentages, not token estimates
read-only: never refreshes or rewrites tokens
